result.result_summary: kafkadesk.org root fetch succeeded but returned unrelated gambling-affiliate content; /category/czech-republic/ returned 404.

why_it_matters: Prevents a stale entry being added to the source registry, and flags that any historical Kafkadesk URLs already held elsewhere in the registry are now unsafe to re-fetch or cite.

description: The two most authoritative sources in this cell - Reuters and Bloomberg - could not be inspected. Reuters and thebanker.com were refused at the fetch-tool layer ('unable to fetch from this domain'); Bloomberg returned HTTP 403 with Retry-After: 0.

result.result_summary: reuters.com: tool-level domain block. thebanker.com: tool-level domain block. bloomberg.com: HTTP 403 bot defence.

why_it_matters: No section URLs, feed paths or paywall specifics could be confirmed for the highest-credibility English sources on Czech banking. These are access hypotheses to resolve, not evidence that anything is unavailable - all three are certainly live. Practically, all three will need licensed access rather than collection.

description: No RSS/Atom feed URL was exposed in the fetched markup for Expats.cz, Prague Morning, Emerging Europe, Retail Banker International or bne IntelliNews. Only Finextra published an explicit feed path (/rss/rss.aspx); The Paypers and Global Finance reference feeds/newsletters without a confirmed URL.

result.result_summary: 1 of ~8 candidate outlets exposed a confirmed feed URL; the rest will require HTML listing polling or feed-path probing.

why_it_matters: Collection cost for this cell is higher than a news-cell normally implies: most sources need scheduled HTML listing polls with entity filtering rather than cheap feed subscriptions, and several are WordPress sites where standard feed paths should be probed before writing scrapers.

description: PYMNTS, one of the largest English payments publications, showed no Czech-focused articles on the first page of its own 'Czech' search; results skewed EU-wide and Poland-centric.

result.result_summary: On-site search returned 48 pages of nominal matches but no Czech-specific headline in the visible results.

why_it_matters: Sets realistic expectations: the global payments trade press treats the Czech market as incidental. Czech payments signal is more likely to come from Finextra company updates, The Paypers M&A items and Czech-language sources than from the large US-centric payments outlets.

description: Several plausible section paths guessed from site conventions returned 404 and were corrected against each site's own navigation: expats.cz Business & Money is /czech-news/economy (not /section/business-money or /business); Prague Morning economics is /category/news/politics-economics/ (not /category/business/); Finextra has no query-string search endpoint at /search or /newssearch; ctk.eu has no /services/foreign_service/ page.

result.result_summary: 4 guessed paths 404'd and were replaced with navigation-derived URLs; 1 (Finextra search) has no query-string equivalent at all.

why_it_matters: Documents that the URLs recorded for these candidates were read from site navigation rather than assumed, and warns the collection layer not to construct section URLs by convention for these domains.

description: Part Five of Decree 163/2014 Sb. and its Annexes 10 and 13 — the provisions that created the standardized quarterly 'Povinně uveřejňované informace' set — were repealed with effect from 1 July 2025. The ČNB's own bank link-index now dates the decree basis as valid only 'until 30.6.2025' and states that institutions may continue disclosing voluntarily under the Banking Act, while prudential disclosure is being centralised at the EBA under CRR Art. 434/434a.

result.result_summary: The legal compulsion behind this cell has ended. Empirically, publication has NOT stopped: MONETA (2Q 2026), PPF banka (30.6.2026), Fio (H1 2026), ČEB (30.6.2026), Citfin (30.6.2026), Artesa (31.3.2026), RSTS (mid-2026) all continued past the repeal. But continuation is now voluntary, so uniformity and comparability are at risk of eroding institution by institution, silently.

why_it_matters: The cell rationale ('Czech law forces each credit institution to publish…') is now historically true rather than currently true. Collection design must add a drift monitor: per-institution detection of a missed quarter, a changed file layout, or a dropped annex, plus a parallel track on the EBA Pillar 3 Data Hub as the successor. The 2011-2025 archive should be mirrored now, while it is still online.

description: The ČNB master index of bank disclosure URLs contains multiple entries that no longer resolve as published. Observed: PPF banka (404, site migrated to /cs/dokumenty/), Česká exportní banka (404, path restructured), ČSOB Stavební spořitelna listed as cmss.cz (HTTPS connection refused; entity rebranded onto csobstavebni.cz), Buřinka listed as burinka.cz (301 to burinka.csas.cz), Raiffeisen stavební spořitelna (301 into /dokumenty/), MONETA (301 to investors.moneta.cz), Modrá pyramida (TLS certificate now presents kb.cz), Hypoteční banka listed under the retired hypotecnibanka.cz although the entity trades as ČSOB Hypoteční banka on csobhypotecni.cz, and Max banka listed although it ceased to exist on 1.10.2024.

result.result_summary: Roughly a third of the regulator's own deep links are stale in some way. All were recovered or diagnosed via the recovery ladder; none were confirmed genuinely dead.

why_it_matters: The authoritative index cannot be treated as ground truth for URLs — only for the entity list. Any collector must resolve redirects, follow renames and re-derive deep links from each institution's own navigation, and should re-run that resolution on a schedule.

description: Automated fetches were refused by several of the largest institutions' disclosure pages: ČSOB (HTTP 500 on both the ČNB-listed /portal/... path and the live /csob/... path), ČSOB Hypoteční banka (500), UniCredit Bank CZ&SK (403), Banka CREDITAS (403), ČSOB Stavební spořitelna successor domain (500). All of these URLs are simultaneously search-indexed with live titles.

result.result_summary: Treated as bot defence, not as dead pages. No liveness verdict is asserted here.

why_it_matters: The four systemically important banks are disproportionately represented among the blocked endpoints, so a naive HTTP collector would silently lose the most important half of the sector. Collection for this cell needs a real-browser tier from the outset.

description: Česká spořitelna and Air Bank both bury the statutory disclosure set behind a client-side-rendered document hub. csas.cz/cs/dokumenty-ke-stazeni returns only a header and a loading placeholder to a plain fetch; the disclosure category is reachable only via the SPA fragment #/7/Povinne-informace-v-souladu-s-Vyhlas. airbank.cz/dokumenty-ke-stazeni exposes the tab label 'Povinně uveřejňované informace' but not the file list.

result.result_summary: Sources are live and open but not harvestable by plain HTTP; no file URLs were obtained for either institution.

why_it_matters: Two of the largest retail banks in the country are affected. Also means URL-verification of the fragment form may report a false pass (the shell loads fine while the content is absent).

description: Terminology in this cell is not standardized despite the template being standardized. Observed variants across institutions: 'povinně uveřejňované informace' (majority), 'povinně zveřejňované informace' (Trinity Bank, Česká exportní banka, J&T IS), 'povinné údaje o bance' (UniCredit), 'informace o bance' (KB), 'údaje uveřejňované čtvrtletně' (PPF banka), 'informace dle vyhlášky ČNB' (ČMSS), 'informační povinnost' (J&T, MONETA legacy), 'veřejné informace' (Artesa, NEY), 'povinné informace' (Peněžní dům, Akcenta), 'hospodářské výsledky' (Fio), 'výsledky hospodaření' (Raiffeisenbank), 'dokumenty ke stažení' (Air Bank, Partners Banka, Česká spořitelna). Separately, 'informační povinnost' is a high-noise term because it also denotes issuer disclosure under the Capital Markets Act and reporting duties TOWARD the ČNB.

result.result_summary: No single search string finds the cell. The uveřejňovaný/zveřejňovaný alternation alone splits results roughly in two.

why_it_matters: Any keyword-driven rediscovery or site-search fallback must run the full variant set, including the zveřejňované spelling, or it will systematically miss a subset of institutions. Disambiguate 'informační povinnost' with 'banka' plus 'čtvrtletní' or 'vyhláška'.

description: Three ČNB link-indexes discovered on the informační-povinnosti hub were not expanded within this slice: investment companies (prehledu-odkazu-...-is-...), pension companies (...penzijnich-spolecnosti...), and the full 35-row securities-dealer list (only the first 10 rows were retrieved). The EBA Pillar 3 Data Hub public portal was also not enumerated.

result.result_summary: Pointer pages identified and their URLs captured, but their member lists were not harvested.

why_it_matters: The securities-dealer list in particular contains payments/FX actors (AKCENTA CZ, Citfin - Finanční trhy) that belong in the payments half of this run; the remaining 25 rows are unexamined. The P3DH enumeration determines whether the whole per-bank scraping estate can eventually be retired.

description: Wüstenrot hypoteční banka a.s. appears as a regulated subsidiary with its own results section on MONETA's investor site, but was not present in the ČNB bank disclosure link-index retrieved for this slice. Conversely, EEA-passported branches operating in Czechia (mBank S.A., Citibank Europe plc, ING Bank N.V., BNP Paribas, Deutsche Bank, Oberbank AG) are absent by design, since the Czech disclosure duty covers only banks and third-country branches.

result.result_summary: One possible index omission found; the EEA-branch absence is a genuine scope boundary, not an omission.

why_it_matters: The regulator's index is the seed list, so an omission propagates into a permanent blind spot. It also means a material slice of the Czech market (the EEA branches) is structurally invisible in this cell and must be covered from home-country or group disclosures in another cell.

description: The session's web-search budget (200 calls) was exhausted before two planned local-language queries could run: MONETA Stavební Spořitelna's own disclosure deep link, and a direct query for the ČNB securities-dealer link-index. Both were partly recovered by direct fetches instead, but no dedicated local-language search was run for the building-society tier as a whole (e.g. 'stavební spořitelna povinně uveřejňované informace čtvrtletní údaje') or for the 'povinně zveřejňované informace' spelling variant.

result.result_summary: Coverage of banks and credit unions is thorough; the building-society tier and the spelling-variant sweep are thinner than intended.

why_it_matters: A follow-up pass should run the variant-spelling and building-society queries specifically, since the glossary finding above shows that spelling alone partitions the result space.

description: No actual disclosure file (XLSX/ZIP) was opened in this slice — only the index pages listing them. Claims about which fields the template carries (capital and capital adequacy, ownership, organisational chart, branch and staff counts) rest on the decree's description of Annex 10 plus the field lists published on the Artesa and NEY pages, not on inspection of a parsed file.

result.result_summary: Field-level structure is inferred, not verified.

why_it_matters: Before a parser is built, at least one XLSX per institution class (large bank, small bank, third-country branch, building society, credit union) should be opened to confirm that the annex layouts really are identical across issuers and stable across the 2014/2017/2021 decree amendments.

description: No RSS/Atom feed or documented API for BCPP issuer announcements was found. The /novinky and /en/news pages expose only a JS-rendered search UI (source filter PSE vs ČTK, keyword with AND/OR and Czech diacritics, From/To date range) and the Press Centre page advertises no feed either — only the @prazskaburza X/Twitter account as a push channel.

result.result_summary: Searched and fetched pse.cz/novinky, pse.cz/en/news and pse.cz/en/press; no feed URL surfaced in the rendered content or the navigation. This is a not-found, not a proof of absence — an undocumented JSON listing endpoint very likely backs the search UI and should be found by inspecting network traffic in a real browser.

why_it_matters: Collection of the exchange announcement channel will need JS rendering or endpoint reverse-engineering rather than a cheap feed poll, which raises cost and fragility for the single most time-sensitive source in this cell.

description: Two high-value branches of the BCPP bulk server returned HTTP 401 Unauthorized on directory listing: http://ftp.pse.cz/Issuers.dta/ (probable issuer master data) and http://ftp.pse.cz/Vestnik.doc/ (Burzovní věstník, the official exchange gazette). Sibling branches on the same host (Annual.rep, Semiannual.rep, Info.bas, Statist.dta) listed normally over plain HTTP.

result.result_summary: 401 on both; recorded as bot-defended-or-gated hypotheses, not as dead sources. Not retried with a browser user-agent or over https within this run.

why_it_matters: The Věstník is the legally authoritative, dated record of admissions, suspensions and exclusions — precisely the artefact that makes the exchange channel valuable when an IR page is later edited. Losing it forces reliance on the softer /novinky items and on ČNB OAM.

description: Across all four BCPP equity segments there is currently no Czech listed pure-play payments or fintech issuer. Banking equity exposure is three names (Komerční banka, Moneta Money Bank, Erste Group Bank, all Prime). The nearest payments exposure is SAB Finance (Standard Market, CZ0009009940, FX/payment services) and WAG Payment Solutions/Eurowag (Free Market, GB00BLGXWY71 — a UK-incorporated dual listing whose primary regulated disclosure is not Czech). The START roster at scan time (BEZVAVLASY, EMAN, FILLAMENTUM, FIXED.ZONE, HARDWARIO, M&T 1997, M2C, MMCITÉ, PILULKA LÉKÁRNY, PRABOS PLUS) contains no fintech; EMAN is the only software house with banking-adjacent work.

result.result_summary: Confirmed by reading all four segment lists directly; Czech-language search on 'trh START fintech platební společnost IPO' surfaced only general START/IPO commentary and no fintech listing in 2024–2025.

why_it_matters: The cell rationale assumed START would capture smaller fintechs that bank lists miss; at present it does not. The bond channel, not the equity channel, is where the Czech banking sector actually shows up on this venue — which reweights collection towards the debt-securities lists and the ČNB OAM.

description: Guessed URL https://www.pse.cz/en/market-data/bonds/prime-market returned HTTP 404. The real path for debt instruments is /en/market-data/debt-securities/{corporate-sector|financial-sector|public-sector|other-debt-securities}. Separately, https://www.cdcp.cz/index.php/cz/11-emitenti-a-administratori (surfaced by search) returned 404 on fetch, and https://www.pse.cz/en/issuer-guide failed the fetch tool's domain safety check on one attempt while other pse.cz pages fetched normally in the same run.

result.result_summary: Recorded as URL-structure/transient findings, not as dead sources — the CDCP issuers page almost certainly moved during a site restructure, and the pse.cz safety-check failure was inconsistent within the same session.

why_it_matters: A verification pass that treats these as dead would wrongly drop two live sources. It also shows that BCPP does not mirror its equity URL structure for bonds, so a collector must be told the debt paths explicitly.

description: Several BCPP pages return only navigation chrome to a plain HTML fetch and load their substance client-side: the Event Calendar (/en/event-calendar), the news listings (/novinky, /en/news — the fetch showed a 'Nahrávám' loading state), the per-issuer News tab (/en/detail/{ISIN}?tab=news returned no headlines), and the Official Price List filtered view.

result.result_summary: Confirmed on four separate fetches. Static content (market-data segment lists, rules pages, press page, ftp listings) fetched fine.

why_it_matters: Sets the technical floor for this cell: a headless-browser or endpoint-level collector is required for the time-sensitive announcement and calendar surfaces, while the roster and archive surfaces can be collected with simple HTTP.

description: A BCPP staging/test host, tst22.pse.cz, is publicly reachable and indexed by search engines, serving apparently complete copies of issuer detail pages and FAQ pages (e.g. tst22.pse.cz/detail/CZ0009011086, tst22.pse.cz/detail/CZ0009011920, tst22.pse.cz/faq-investor-obchodovani). The ftp server likewise exposes TESTIssuers.dta and TESTresults branches.

result.result_summary: Observed repeatedly in search results across three separate queries. Not fetched or relied upon.

why_it_matters: Do NOT collect from tst22.pse.cz: staging content is unversioned, may be stale or synthetic, and using it would corrupt provenance for a channel whose whole value is authoritative timestamping. Flagged so a crawler configuration explicitly blocklists the host rather than treating it as a convenient mirror.

description: No permanent per-issuer announcement archive URL was found on pse.cz. The issuer detail page's News block links out to the site-wide /en/news search rather than to a filtered, stable per-ISIN announcement history, and no 'regulated information' section distinct from the general news feed exists on the exchange site.

result.result_summary: Checked the Czech and English KB pages, the Moneta news tab and the news landing pages; the only route to an issuer's history is a keyword query (e.g. "Komerční banka") against the general news search, which mixes BCPP notices with ČTK newswire items.

why_it_matters: Per-issuer historical reconstruction on the exchange channel depends on keyword search quality and on the PSE/ČTK source flag being captured correctly; for authoritative per-issuer history the ČNB OAM repository must carry the load instead.

description: No established Czech-language term or dedicated BCPP page was found for an exchange-side 'delisted / former issuers' register. Czech searches using 'vyřazené emise', 'vyloučení emise z obchodování' and 'vyřazení z obchodování' returned only individual news items (e.g. the AVAST exclusion from Free Market on 24 February 2022, ISIN GB00BDD85M81; the JUVENTUS F.C. suspension and re-listing under a new ISIN after a reverse split) rather than a consolidated list.

result.result_summary: Local-language coverage was attempted and produced item-level results only; the consolidated register does not appear to exist publicly under any term I could find.

why_it_matters: Historical issuer-universe reconstruction (which Czech financial-sector companies once carried disclosure duty) cannot be done from a single BCPP page and will have to be assembled from dated news items, the Věstník (currently 401), or CDCP records.

description: ČNB's Otevřená data page exposes exactly seven datasets (banks and branches of foreign banks, exchange offices, non-bank consumer credit providers, independent credit intermediaries, tied credit representatives, tied credit intermediaries, foreign credit intermediaries). There is NO open dataset for platební instituce, instituce elektronických peněz, poskytovatelé platebních služeb malého rozsahu or vydavatelé elektronických peněz malého rozsahu.

result.result_summary: Bulk CSV/JSON access covers the banking and credit-intermediation side only; the payments population must be obtained by scraping JERRS, by using WS JERRS with a certificate, from the ČNB PSRI statistical list, or from the EBA PSD2 register.

why_it_matters: The payments half of the sector — the fastest-changing population and the one most relevant to a payments market-intelligence programme — has no frictionless machine-readable feed from the national regulator. Collection design must not assume symmetry with the banking datasets.

description: WS JERRS, the only official API over the register of regulated entities, requires a commercial certificate from an approved CA and an electronically signed access request emailed to jerrsws@cnb.cz before any call can be made.

result.result_summary: No anonymous or key-based access exists; provisioning is a manual, paperwork-bound process with an unknown lead time.

why_it_matters: The cleanest entity feed cannot be switched on in a research sprint. Either budget for the certificate and application process up front, or design the pipeline around HTML scraping plus the seven open-data CSVs from day one.

description: A guessed JERRS deep link (https://jerrs.cnb.cz/apljerrsdad/JERRS.WEB10.HLEDANI_SUBJEKTU?p_lang=cz) returned HTTP 500. The ČNB applications are Oracle PL/SQL web apps whose procedure names and parameters are not documented publicly.

result.result_summary: Hypothesis, not a verdict: the entry points that were actually observed (JERRS.WEB07.INTRO_PAGE, JERRS.WEB45.LOGIN_A, SIPRESWEB.WEB21/WEB_PROSPECTUS/WEB_SHORTSELL.START_INPUT_OAM) responded, so the apps are live; only the invented procedure name failed.

why_it_matters: Collectors must navigate from the ČNB short-links (/cnb/jerrs, /cnb/registr_prospektu, /cnb/kratke_pozice_cz) and follow redirects and forms rather than hard-coding internal procedure URLs, which will break or 500 without notice.

description: Several fetches of www.cnb.cz returned ECONNRESET, 'socket hang up', or a domain-safety block from the fetching layer, while the same or adjacent URLs succeeded on retry.

result.result_summary: Treated as transient network/bot-defence behaviour, NOT as evidence that any ČNB URL is dead. All ČNB URLs recorded here are unverified for liveness by design and must be confirmed by the deterministic verification pass.

why_it_matters: A naive liveness checker will mark ČNB pages dead on first failure and prune the single most important source cluster in the whole CZ landscape. Retries with backoff and a realistic user agent are required.

description: For the ČNB Registr prospektů it could not be confirmed from the register's own page whether the full prospectus PDFs are hosted and downloadable from ČNB, or whether the register carries only metadata plus a reference to the issuer's own publication. ČNB explicitly states that publication in the list does not replace the issuer's publication duty under Regulation (EU) 2017/1129.

result.result_summary: Open question requiring a hands-on retrieval test against a known Czech bank base prospectus.

why_it_matters: Determines whether the prospectus collector is a document harvester or only a metadata index that must then be joined to issuer websites — a materially different build.

description: The European Single Access Point, which is intended to aggregate national OAM content including the ČNB Central Storage, is not yet a usable source: collection from collection bodies is scheduled to begin around July 2026 with public access targeted for July 2027 under Regulation (EU) 2023/2859.

result.result_summary: ESAP cannot be used as a substitute for scraping the ČNB OAM in the current run; it is a watch item, not a source.

why_it_matters: Avoids designing the CZ disclosure collector around an access point that will not deliver data in this planning horizon, while flagging a foreseeable migration that will reduce scraping cost later.

description: Two local-language pitfalls were observed. First, the bare phrase 'seznam ČNB' is heavily reused by commercial finance portals (finanza.cz, penize.cz and similar) that republish ČNB register extracts, so it retrieves mirrors rather than the primary source. Second, 'OAM' is not Czech usage — it is the EU 'officially appointed mechanism' concept surviving only in the oam.cnb.cz hostname; the Czech public name is 'centrální úložiště regulovaných informací'.

result.result_summary: Searches must use the full Czech official names; the acronym OAM is useful only for URL pattern matching, not for Czech-language retrieval.

why_it_matters: Query design that relies on acronyms or short forms will surface secondary aggregators and mis-attribute authority, contaminating a source register meant to record primary sources.

description: No robots.txt, terms-of-use or re-use licence was read for www.cnb.cz, oam.cnb.cz, jerrs.cnb.cz, or.justice.cz or pse.cz during this run.

result.result_summary: Legal status recorded for each candidate is inferred from the public-register character of the sources and, for the ČNB open data, from the explicit open-data regime under nařízení vlády č. 425/2016 Sb. — not from a read licence document, except where stated.

why_it_matters: Automated collection at scale should be gated on an explicit robots/ToS check per host before the collectors go into production, particularly for or.justice.cz and pse.cz which are not open-data publishers.

description: Free public access to the Czech beneficial-ownership register (Evidence skutečných majitelů) was withdrawn. The Ministry of Justice announced that from 17 December 2025 the public part of ESM and its open data are unavailable, citing Czech Supreme Court / Supreme Administrative Court and CJEU case law on disproportionate interference with privacy and the transposition of the new EU AML package.

result.result_summary: esm.justice.cz still responds, but the freely searchable public extract and open-data distribution that this cell relied on for ultimate-ownership mapping are no longer available to an unauthenticated researcher; access now requires data-box login, privileged remote access, an AML-obliged-entity form, or proof of legitimate interest before a court.

why_it_matters: Ownership of Czech payment institutions, processors and ATM/IT vendors is frequently held through layered holdings; without ESM the register only shows the registered shareholder, so ultimate control must now be inferred from úplný výpis history, related-party reports in the deeds collection, or bought from commercial databases.

description: The Ministry of Justice open-data catalogue (dataor.justice.cz) is a client-side React application whose datasets are served through CKAN-style endpoints discovered in its JavaScript bundle: /api/3/action/package_list_compact, /api/3/action/package_show and /api/file/.

result.result_summary: Calling /api/3/action/package_list_compact without parameters returned HTTP 400 with a zero-byte body, and /api/3/action/package_show?id=full returned 'MissingObject{type=ShowResult, id=full}'. The correct dataset identifiers and query parameters were not determined in this run; they are documented in the 81-page ISVR open-data user manual (sections 3-4) which was downloaded but not fully read.

why_it_matters: This is the only bulk, non-rate-limited path to the whole Czech register; until the parameters are worked out, the actor-universe build stays dependent on the rate-limited and CAPTCHA-protected or.justice.cz web UI.

description: No bulk or API distribution of the Sbírka listin documents themselves (the annual report / financial statement PDFs) was found. The ISVR open data covers register entries — the user manual's structure is organised by legal form and its mandatory/optional attribute sets (s.r.o., a.s., družstvo, nadace, SVJ...), i.e. subject data, not filed documents.

result.result_summary: The documents appear to be reachable only per entity, through or.justice.cz/ias/ui/vypis-sl-firma?subjektId={id} and then vypis-sl-detail?dokument={id}&subjektId={id}&spis={id}.

why_it_matters: Collecting the disclosures at scale therefore requires an entity-by-entity crawl inside the ministry's published limits (3000 requests/day, 50/minute, random CAPTCHA), which shapes the whole collection architecture and argues for a licensed commercial mirror as a complement.

description: The ISVR open-data usage terms (dataor.justice.cz/files/ISVR_OpenData_Podminky_uziti.pdf, v1.0, 4 March 2019) permit users to disseminate, use and cite the data and to use it 'pro nekomerční použití' (for non-commercial use), and state that the distribution contains personal data so the recipient becomes a data controller under GDPR.

result.result_summary: The same document states the distribution is neither a copyright-protected database nor protected by the sui generis database right, so its structure and content may be freely extracted and reused — but the non-commercial usage wording and the GDPR controller status are unresolved for a commercial market-intelligence programme.

why_it_matters: A commercial intelligence product built on bulk ISVR data may exceed the stated licence; this needs legal review before ingestion, whereas per-entity public register lookups and ARES API use are not covered by that clause.

description: Three candidate URLs failed on first probe and were recovered rather than recorded as dead: https://csu.gov.cz/registr-ekonomickych-subjektu returned 404 (RES application recovered at https://apl.czso.cz/irsw/); a deep link into rzp.gov.cz (/verejne-udaje/cs/udaje/vyber-subjektu.html) failed to connect (working root https://rzp.gov.cz/); https://www.hlidacstatu.cz/api/v2/doc returned 404 while the live documentation sits at /api/v1/doc. Separately https://www.dnb.com/cs-cz.html returned 404 while https://www.dnb.com/cs-cz/ resolved, and bisnode.cz / albertina.cz both redirect there (rebrand, not death).

result.result_summary: All five were recovered to working equivalents via root/nav or entity research; none is a genuinely dead source.

why_it_matters: Documents the recovery ladder outcomes so a later verify pass does not re-flag these as broken, and records the Bisnode->Dun & Bradstreet rebrand for entity resolution.

description: Two Czech term collisions were observed during searching. 'ARES' resolves both to the official Ministry of Finance system at ares.gov.cz and to an unrelated private look-alike at ares.cz (plus aresgov.cz). 'Sbírka' is ambiguous: 'sbírka listin' (collection of deeds) versus 'e-Sbírka' / 'Sbírka zákonů' (the collection of laws at zakony.gov.cz), which surfaced in results for a deeds-related query.

result.result_summary: Queries mixing 'sbírka' with 'API/otevřená data' pulled e-Sbírka legal-code results; queries for 'ARES' pulled the private mirror above the official system.

why_it_matters: Both terms need disambiguators ('sbírka listin' + 'obchodní rejstřík'; 'ARES' + 'ares.gov.cz' or 'ekonomické subjekty') or the collection pipeline will ingest the wrong corpus or cite an unofficial mirror as the official register.

description: The session's web-search budget (200 calls) was exhausted partway through this cell, after which no further WebSearch queries could be issued.

result.result_summary: Planned follow-up searches — notably Czech-language searches for the ČNB list of licensed payment institutions, for 'výroční zpráva a účetní závěrka uložená do sbírky listin 2025 platební', and for bulk deeds-download tooling — were not run as searches. Affected sources were instead reached by direct URL probing and by snowballing links out of already-fetched pages, so ČNB's JERRS register is recorded on a direct probe alone rather than on search evidence.

why_it_matters: Coverage of this cell is grounded but not exhaustive; a follow-up run with search budget should re-run the unexecuted seed queries, especially the 2025-specific filing query.

description: The new ministry portal verejnerejstriky.msp.gov.cz (announced on or.justice.cz as running in 'ověřovací provoz') is a Nuxt application whose search runs client-side; its deep-link route scheme was not determined.

result.result_summary: Guessed routes /vyhledavani, /vyhledat, /sbirka-listin and /subjekt/{ico} all returned 404, while the root and the /clanky/... article pages responded. Its client state exposes three search scopes (publicRegister, trusts, realOwners).

why_it_matters: When the legacy or.justice.cz URL patterns are retired, the whole deeds-collection crawler must be re-pointed; the replacement URL scheme is still unknown and needs a headless-browser session to capture.

description: Searched in Czech for a national aggregator of covered-bond investor reports / cover-pool data (terms: 'kryté dluhopisy', 'krytý blok', 'evidence krytých bloků', 'seznam emitentů', ČNB Vyhláška č. 2/2019 Sb. o evidenci krytých bloků). ČNB maintains the register of permitted covered blocks and labelled ISINs, and issuers must regularly report to ČNB on compliance, but no public Czech portal publishes the underlying cover-pool data.

result.result_summary: No national HTT/cover-pool portal exists for CZ. Cover-pool disclosure is issuer-by-issuer (KB, UniCredit CZ&SK, MONETA, Česká spořitelna) plus the pan-European Covered Bond Label. The ČNB register gives issuer names, LEI/IČO and ISINs only — no pool composition, LTV, OC or arrears data.

why_it_matters: Collection for this cell cannot be centralised on one regulator feed. The pipeline must fan out to six issuer sites (some bot-defended) and to coveredbondlabel.com, and must treat the ČNB list as the completeness check rather than the data source.

description: Plain HTTP fetches to several Czech bank disclosure hosts were refused: unicreditbank.cz returned HTTP 403 on both /cs/o-bance/dluhopisy-prehled.html and /en/ostatni/debt-investor-relations.html; creditas.cz returned 403 on /o-bance/pro-investory; csob.cz returned HTTP 500 on /csob/povinne-uverejnovane-informace; csobhypotecni.cz returned HTTP 500 on /o-bance/emise-hzl and /o-bance/zpravy-o-hospodareni-dokumenty/.

result.result_summary: Four issuer hosts are unreadable by simple fetch, yet PDF documents on the very same hosts are indexed and referenced from search results, which strongly suggests bot defence / edge-WAF behaviour rather than dead pages.

why_it_matters: This is a hypothesis, not a verdict — none of these should be recorded as dead. The collector for this cell needs a headless-browser tier with realistic headers for HTML index pages, while direct GET on /content/dam/, /documents/ and /files/ PDF paths appears sufficient for the documents themselves.

description: coveredbondlabel.com issuer pages and the issuer directory were fetched statically. The Komerční banka issuer page (id 177) rendered its contact list, pool programme list, bond list and HTT section all as '0-10 of 0', and /issuers/directory rendered an empty filter table. /issuers and /national-information both returned HTTP 404.

result.result_summary: The Label's Czech data exists but is client-side rendered; static scraping yields empty tables and would falsely suggest Czech issuers publish nothing.

why_it_matters: A naive collector would record the three labelled Czech issuers as having no HTT filings. Headless rendering is mandatory here, and the correct paths are /issuers/directory, /issuers/national/list, /new-htt and /htt-database.

description: Raiffeisenbank a.s. (covered blocks RBCZ_BLOCK_02 and RBCZ_BLOCK_03, with labelled issue XS3019003253) and Hypoteční banka (HB-Blok 4) both appear in the ČNB covered-block register, but Czech- and English-language searching surfaced no dedicated public cover-pool/HTT/investor-report page for either. RBCZ's securities page references an 'International Covered Bonds Programme' without a linked cover-pool report; Hypoteční banka's trail is prospectus/emisní-dodatek only. Neither was found among Covered Bond Label issuers (KB, UniCredit CZ&SK and Česká spořitelna were the three identified).

result.result_summary: Two of six licensed Czech covered-block issuers have no located public cover-pool disclosure surface.

why_it_matters: Cover-pool coverage for CZ is structurally incomplete: any CZ-wide covered-bond comparison built from public sources will be missing Raiffeisenbank and Hypoteční banka, which must be flagged rather than silently treated as zero.

description: No settled Czech-language term for 'senior non-preferred' was found in issuer or regulator material. Czech sources use descriptive constructions — 'nepodřízené dluhopisy', 'podřízené dluhopisy', 'MREL dluhopisy', 'způsobilé závazky' — and Raiffeisenbank's own documents use the English 'SNP (Senior Non Preferred)' inside Czech text. Similarly, 'covered bond' has three coexisting Czech renderings depending on vintage and legal basis: the historic 'hypoteční zástavní listy (HZL)', the post-2019 statutory 'kryté dluhopisy' / 'krytý blok', and the EU-label 'evropský krytý dluhopis (prémiový)'.

result.result_summary: Local-language querying works, but only with an explicitly multi-vintage term set; a single-term query misses whole eras of documents.

why_it_matters: Any CZ query set for this cell must fire all of {hypoteční zástavní listy, HZL, kryté dluhopisy, krytý blok, evropský krytý dluhopis, emisní dodatek, konečné podmínky, základní prospekt, MREL dluhopisy, způsobilé závazky} plus the English-in-Czech forms (SNP, MREL, HTT, cover pool), or recall collapses.

description: The Czech terms 'dluhopisy' and 'emise dluhopisů' are heavily contaminated by the Czech retail corporate-bond and mini-bond scene (dluhopisy.cz, dluhopisar.cz, srovnavacdluhopisu.cz, KB's large archive of arranged client issues for Accolade, Allwyn, CZG, Dr. Max, RegioJet and others) and by bank product pages selling third-party bonds. Searching 'banka emise dluhopisů' without qualifiers returns mostly non-bank issuers for whom the bank is merely arranger or paying agent.

result.result_summary: Broad Czech bond queries have low precision for bank-as-issuer material.

why_it_matters: Query design must anchor on issuer-role terms ('emitent', 'povinně uveřejňované informace', 'krytý blok', 'MREL') or on the named six licensed issuers; otherwise the collector fills up with corporate mini-bond noise that belongs to a different cell entirely.

description: The session's WebSearch budget (200/200) was consumed before three planned lines of enquiry could be run: (a) the Czech-language route into the ČNB OAM application interface and its filter vocabulary, (b) ČNB ARAD time series for HZL/covered-bond outstanding volumes, and (c) MREL/bond issuance by second-tier Czech deposit-takers and building societies (Air Bank / PPF banka, J&T Banka, Fio banka, Českomoravská stavební spořitelna, Modrá pyramida, Trinity Bank).

result.result_summary: Three known-relevant sub-areas were left unsearched; they are recorded as coverage gaps rather than as absent sources.

why_it_matters: Absence of these from the candidate list reflects a run constraint, not a finding that the sources do not exist. They should be the first queries in any follow-up run for this cell.

description: English-language searching was run in parallel with Czech throughout ('Czech building society annual report subsidiary Erste KBC Societe Generale Raiffeisen disclosure', 'Czech credit union cooperative savings annual report disclosure Pillar 3') and returned almost nothing usable at entity level for this cell.

result.result_summary: English queries returned parent-group material (KBC Group annual reports, the 2019 KBC/ČSOB buyout of BSH's 45% ČMSS stake) and generic EBA/Basel Pillar 3 documents, but no CZ non-bank subsidiary disclosure pages. Of the five building societies, only Raiffeisen stavební spořitelna (confirmed bilingual PDFs 2020–2025) and MONETA Stavební Spořitelna (bilingual IR pages) publish English. Buřinka's annual-report index is Czech-only; ČNB's disclosure indexes were reached only via Czech URLs. No English-language disclosure page was found for any credit union or pension company.

why_it_matters: Any collector built on English queries would miss roughly the entire cell. Retrieval must be Czech-first, and downstream extraction must handle Czech financial terminology (výroční zpráva, účetní závěrka, účastnický fond, transformovaný fond, povinně uveřejňované informace) rather than expecting English equivalents.

description: The URL ČNB's official bank-disclosure index still gives for ČSOB Stavební spořitelna is https://www.cmss.cz/informace-dle-vyhlasky-cnb, from the pre-rebrand Českomoravská stavební spořitelna era.

result.result_summary: One fetch of that URL returned ECONNREFUSED 193.245.72.249:443. A targeted Czech search recovered a live replacement at csobstavebni.cz with both /vyrocni-zpravy and /informace-dle-vyhlasky-cnb. Recorded as a stale-domain hypothesis, not a dead source — the entity is plainly active.

why_it_matters: Even the authoritative regulator index carries lagging URLs after rebrands. A collector must treat an index entry failure as a rename signal and re-resolve the entity by name/IČO rather than marking it dead, or it will silently lose the largest building society in the market.

description: https://www.modrapyramida.cz/dokumenty could not be fetched by the strict-TLS fetcher.

result.result_summary: Error: 'Hostname/IP does not match certificate's altnames: Host: www.modrapyramida.cz is not in the cert's altnames: DNS:www.kb.cz, DNS:kb.cz'. Hypothesis: the domain is now served from Komerční banka infrastructure as part of the ongoing absorption of Modrá pyramida into KB, so content is live but the certificate does not cover the legacy hostname.

why_it_matters: This is the single most strategically loaded entity in the cell (branch conversion to KB poradenská místa, advisor absorption, servicing moved to KB+) and it is exactly the one a naive fetcher drops. Collection needs a browser-grade client, plus kb.cz and Sbírka listin as parallel routes.

description: Searched in Czech for Investiční společnost České spořitelny's mandatory disclosures as a candidate bank-group investment firm.

result.result_summary: ISČS ceased to exist as a Czech legal entity: Erste Asset Management GmbH became sole shareholder in 2009 and a cross-border merger in 2015 absorbed ISČS into Erste Asset Management GmbH, with services now offered through 'Erste Asset Management GmbH, pobočka Česká republika' (IČO 04107128, registered at the Municipal Court in Prague). A branch files differently from a Czech joint-stock company, so there is no equivalent standalone CZ statutory annual report.

why_it_matters: One of the largest bank-group asset managers in CZ has no entity-level Czech annual report to sweep. Coverage of the Erste/ČS asset-management side must instead come from Erste AM group disclosures, REICO (the ČS-group real-estate investment company, which does remain a Czech entity), and AKAT aggregates — otherwise the cell's investment-firm coverage looks complete when it is not.

description: Searched in Czech for the Asociace družstevních záložen (ADZ), the credit-union trade body, expecting an association counterpart to AČSS and APS ČR.

result.result_summary: Only third-party directory profiles were returned (uspory.cz, penize.cz, fintimes.cz, druzstevni-inkubator.cz). Background surfaced: ADZ founded 2001 by WPB Capital, Prague Credit Union and DZ NOVA; roughly five of the credit unions described as members. No official ADZ domain appeared in results, and no association statistics comparable to AČSS or APS ČR were located.

why_it_matters: The credit-union segment has no usable association-level aggregator. Sector totals for družstevní záložny must come from ČNB ARAD and the supervision report, and entity detail must be assembled union by union — a materially more expensive collection pattern than for building societies or pension companies.

description: Sought a consolidated, machine-readable source of branch counts, advisor headcount or self-service/ATM estate for the non-bank licensed entities in this cell.

result.result_summary: No such registry or dataset was found in Czech or English. Channel facts surfaced only as narrative: KB press releases dating the conversion of ~190 Modrá pyramida branches to KB advisory points and the move of ~500 advisors into KB's network, and Patria Finance's own description of developing its trading applications. Nothing equivalent exists as a periodic structured feed.

why_it_matters: The cell's core value — entity-level channel and technology signal — must be extracted from prose in annual reports and press releases rather than read off a table. Collection design should assume text extraction plus manual review, and should prioritise the narrative sections of výroční zprávy over the financial statements.

description: Two plausible-looking disclosure URLs returned HTTP 404 on first fetch: https://www.nrb.cz/o-nas/povinne-zverejnovane-informace/ and https://ceb.cz/informace/povinne-zverejnovane-informace1/vz-html (the latter appeared as a search-result title). Both were constructed or copied rather than confirmed from live navigation.

result.result_summary: Correct live paths were then recovered from each site's own navigation: NRB uses 'povinně UVEŘEJŇOVANÉ informace' (https://www.nrb.cz/o-nas/povinne-uverejnovane-informace/) while ČEB uses 'povinně ZVEŘEJŇOVANÉ informace' (https://www.ceb.cz/informace/povinne-zverejnovane-informace/) with annual reports at /o-bance/vyrocni-zpravy/. Neither 404 is evidence the sites or sections are dead — both are alive under different slugs.

why_it_matters: Czech institutions use two near-identical statutory phrases (uveřejňované vs. zveřejňované) for the same disclosure duty. A collector that hard-codes one variant will silently miss entities using the other, and a liveness checker will record false deaths.

description: Searched for English-language annual reports of Česká exportní banka. The ČEB annual-report index lists Czech-only PDFs for every year 2012-2025 (filenames end in -cs.pdf or are Czech-titled consolidated auditor reports); no English annual report was listed on that page.

result.result_summary: An English site section exists at ceb.cz/en/, but no English annual report file was identified for any year.

why_it_matters: Any downstream comparison of Czech state export finance against peer ECAs or export banks will need Czech-language parsing or machine translation for ČEB; budgeting for that now avoids a silent coverage hole.

description: No English-language version of Garanční systém finančního trhu materials (annual reports, budgets, bond prospectuses) was identified. All documents observed on garancnisystem.cz/dokumenty are Czech-titled.

result.result_summary: GSFT deposit-insurance and resolution-fund reporting appears to be Czech-only in the material found.

why_it_matters: Deposit-insurance fund size and resolution-fund build-up are core comparative metrics across EU markets; Czech-only publication means cross-country benchmarking of the Czech safety net requires local-language extraction.

description: Looked for machine-readable feeds (RSS/Atom, JSON, open-data endpoints) published by the in-cell institutions themselves — NRB, ČEB, EGAP, GSFT. None were identified during this pass; all content is HTML index pages plus PDFs.

result.result_summary: No first-party API or feed found for any of the four core state financial institutions. EGAP additionally uses tokenised one-time-looking download URLs (/cs/file/<id>/download?token=...).

why_it_matters: Collection must be scrape-based with change detection rather than feed-based, and EGAP download links cannot be cached across runs. The only genuinely machine-readable routes in this cell are third-party or cross-cutting (Hlídač státu API, MONITOR státní pokladna open data, Registr smluv dumps).

description: Searched in Czech for EGAP interim/quarterly statistics on insured export volumes ('čtvrtletní data', 'statistiky pojištěného vývozu') as a higher-frequency alternative to the annual report.

result.result_summary: No dedicated quarterly statistics page or dataset was located on egap.cz. The recurring public figures (insured volume, profit, number of policies, destination countries, Fond Ukrajina volumes) appear to be released annually via press release and then re-syndicated by ČTK-fed outlets.

why_it_matters: Intra-year visibility on Czech state-backed export capacity is limited to press releases and to the semi-annual reporting EGAP makes to the Chamber of Deputies; the parliamentary route (psp.cz) may therefore be the only sub-annual quantitative channel and should be prioritised.

description: For Garanční fond obchodníků s cennými papíry (gfo.cz), search results surfaced the homepage and third-party restatements of the fund's rules and older annual reports (2004, 2007, 2016 referenced) but no annual-report index page on gfo.cz was directly confirmed in this pass.

result.result_summary: Entity and its statutory role are confirmed; the location and completeness of its own annual-report archive are not. This is unverified, not absent.

why_it_matters: GFO completes the Czech financial safety-net map alongside GSFT; if its own publication is thin, or.justice.cz filings and CNB records become the fallback route and that needs to be decided before the collection run.

description: Ministry of Finance content is served from two hostnames: legacy mfcr.cz and current mf.gov.cz. A fetch of https://www.mfcr.cz/cs/verejny-sektor/majetek-statu/majetkove-ucasti returned HTTP 308 Permanent Redirect to https://mf.gov.cz/cs/verejny-sektor/majetek-statu/majetkove-ucasti. Both hostnames also appear in live search results with different path prefixes (/cs/kontrola-a-regulace/... vs /cs/verejny-sektor/...).

result.result_summary: Same content, two hosts and at least two path taxonomies. Not a failure, but a deduplication and link-rot hazard.

why_it_matters: Without host and path normalisation, the MF ownership register and financial-market reports will be double-counted or lost when legacy redirects are eventually retired.

description: Multiple independent Czech sources (MPO and MF press releases, NKÚ-related coverage) indicate the government decided to integrate Česká exportní banka into Národní rozvojová banka, with ČEB becoming a subsidiary of NRB, supported by a dedicated Act on the National Development Bank passing the Chamber of Deputies in 2024.

result.result_summary: This is a live restructuring affecting two of the cell's core entities, not a stable steady state. Reporting perimeter, consolidation basis and possibly the publishing domain (ceb.cz) are at risk of change.

why_it_matters: Time series built on standalone ČEB reporting may break; consolidated NRB group reporting may absorb ČEB figures. The source map must record entity lineage (ČMZRB -> NRB; ČEB -> NRB subsidiary) or year-on-year comparisons will be silently wrong.
